Patient complains of shortness of breath even at rest. His attenders say his shortness of breath exacerabated on drinking 90mL of whiskey 4 days back.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient complained of redness and edema of right foot upto ankle with a bullous lesion which was ?aspirated and was put on IV PIPERCILLIN- TAZOBACTUM, the redness has now subsided.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe was diagnosed with Bronchial asthma 10 years back, for which he used ?rotahaler twice a day for 5 months and then discontinued. He reports usage of Tab. Betnesol whenever he felt even slightly out of breath. His son reports frequent over consumption of these tablets.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E5 years back, he had bouts of productive cough for 3 weeks and fever. He was taken to a local hospital where he was diagnosed with Tuberculosis. They opted for treatment from a Private hospital from where he took medication for 6 months but skipped a few doses in between and was irregular.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAt the age of 25, he suffered right sided hemiplegia due to ischemic stroke for which he took treatment for 15 days at a local hospital.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAt the age of 31, according to his wife, he suffered from high grade fever for which he was given ?medication and was advised to not consume alcohol.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBut he consumed alcohol that night and then experienced dysarthria.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe was a coolie by occupation 15 years ago but stopped working due to shortness of breath.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of haemoptysis, COVID 19 infection, or reduced Urinary The pain kept alternating between right and left shoulder and sometimes both simultaneously. She experienced tightness of shoulder joints on waking up and needs someone to pull her up from the bed. Her pain was relieved on medication but it kept recurring for 6 months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/font\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; font-family: Lora, serif;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cfont face=\"Lora, serif\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/font\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cfont face=\"Lora, serif\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;\"\u003EThen she developed fever, oral ulcers, redness of eyes and diminished vision, facial puffiness and went to a private hospital.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/font\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cfont face=\"Lora, serif\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;\"\u003EOn routine investigations, they found that she was losing a lot of proteins in her urine, due to that and her diminishing vision they decided to a kidney biopsy, after which a diagnosis of SLE was made. She was put on Tab. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs. This E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr class=\"Apple-interchange-newline\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto;\" \/\u003E \u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 62 year old female, herder by occupation, came with chief complaints of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cul\u003E\u003Cli\u003EH\/o fall on 28\/3\/22 at 8 PM and 29\/3\/22 at 3 AM\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003EPedal edema till above ankle since 1 week\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003EBurning sensation of right fingertips since 2 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003EDryness of mouth and inability to swallow since 2 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003EDrowsiness since 2 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003EGeneralized weakness since 1 year\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003EEar pain and ringing sensation in ears on and off since 2 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHistory of presenting illness:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 years back and then developed burning sensation of right fingertips since 2 months, which is constant, increases on activity such as mixing food or combing hair. There is no bluish discolouration or paleness of fingers .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe has history of fall on 28\/3\/22 at 8pm when she went to take a bath, she sat on a stool and fell back.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAt 3 AM, she woke up to urinate, went to the washroom and sat in squat position, before she could support herself with her hands she fell on her face and that resulted in a swollen right eye.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2 months back, after getting down the bus, she landed on a sloped surface, lost her balance and tumbled down. She lost her consciousness for 5 minutes and was later woken up by her daughter and was given water. She walked back home after this episode. She had trauma to head and laceration on her left arm.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDryness of mouth since 2 months associated with intolerance to solid foods. She apparently can only swallow if she drinks water along with her food. She feels like her voice has also changed as she feels pain on trying to talk.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe feels excessively drowsy since two months, her attenders tell that she prefers sleeping most of the time and is not doing her chores.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe experiences generalized weakness ever since her husband passed away away due to uncontrolled sugars(both his legs were amputated).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe experienced pain in both her ears associated with ringing sensation, 2 years back. Not associated with any discharge or loss of hearing. She used ? Medication for it and it reduced. But the ringing sensation does come up occasionally.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe has pitting type of pedal edema till above her ankle.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPast history:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn observing, her mouth is deviated to right side, when asked she reveals she experienced an episode of stroke 5 months of age. She says they used a lot of herbal medicine to correct her deviation.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3-4 years on regular check up she was diagnosed with Diabetes Mellitus and is on medication for it.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EGeneral examination\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is conscious, coherent and cooperative.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPallor is present.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, koilonychia, lymphadenopathy.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemp: 98.5\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPR: 90 bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP: 110\/70 mm hg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESpO2: 98%\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cimg alt=\"\" id=\"id_5464_6140_c37e_8c13\" src=\"https:\/\/lh5.googleusercontent.com\/wF2wd1j0yD66hW1Nc8pi5NdIFN4dGD1i29lpkvusgozrDPlQcdmfGsjGfuDuiOgA4_o\" style=\"height: auto;
